NONE: › a priest in the Church of England who is in charge of a church and the religious needs of people in a particular area

NONE: › used as part of the title of particular positions. The person who holds one of these positions is next below in authority to the person who holds the full position and can act for them

C: › [ C ] mainly UK US usually vise a tool with two parts that can be moved together by tightening a screw so that an object can be held firmly between them while it is being worked on

隊伍的副隊長

她的手像老虎鉗子一樣緊緊抓住他的手臂。

NONE: › in the UK, the person in charge of a college or university
（英國大學或學院主持工作的）校長

（美國大學或學院主管部分工作的）副校長

NONE: › a group of people involved in immoral illegal activities, especially illegal sex or drugs
（尤指與性或毒品有關的）犯罪團夥

據認為那些色情電影是由一個國際犯罪團夥分銷出去的。

NONE: › a special group of police officers whose job is to stop crimes that involve sex and drugs
（警方的）掃黃緝毒行動隊

NONE: › very tight

NONE: › relating to a vice president

NONE: › a soup made with potatoes, leeks, and cream, often eaten cold

NONE: C2 Vicious people or actions show an intention or wish to hurt someone or something very badly.

我頭痛得厲害。

NONE: › a continuing unpleasant situation, created when one problem causes another problem that then makes the first problem worse

NONE: › changes that happen at different times during the life or development of someone or something, especially those that result in conditions being worse

失業只是曲折人生中的一個插曲。

我們看來已經成了一個大惡作劇的受害者。

NONE: › the act of providing emotional and practical help for people who suffer because of a crime, or an organization that provides this

NONE: › In a victimless crime no one suffers directly, sometimes because the people affected by the crime have agreed to take part in it.

NONE: › the winner of a game, competition, election, war, etc.

NONE: › objects, especially decorative objects, pictures, and toys, that were made while Queen Victoria was queen of Britain
維多利亞時代的事物（特別是裝飾性器物、圖畫和玩偶）

NONE: › having won a game, competition, election, war, etc.
